purpose: Join repeated paired presentations to stable synthetic reference/condition cases without promoting finite listener summaries to source-population truth or independent sampling evidence.

fixture.case_mapping: One stable case per scenario/source pair, one reference per synthetic source and one condition per case. Generate a separate assignment-to-case lookup before resolving any responses. These are declared fixture relationships, not inferred media identity.
fixture.presentation_mapping: Use the bound assignment's explicit role map and lookup; never parse opaque presentation IDs or use listener-specific stimulus IDs as stable cases.
fixture.incomplete_variant: Only choice-correlated: retain all locked choices but omit both grades and submission for incorrect choices. This outcome-dependent synthetic missingness is a stress fixture, not a selected collection or analysis policy.
fixture.one_case_absent_variant: Only choice-correlated: omit every response for source index 11 while retaining every planned assignment and case.
fixture.all_absent_variant: Only choice-correlated: retain the full registry but provide no response envelopes.
fixture.unchanged_outcomes: All supplied complete events come from the bound paired synthetic generator. No audio, human responses, statistical fits or perceptual metrics are used.

unit_contract.presentation_unit: one assigned listener trial with blinded role aliases
unit_contract.prediction_unit: one exact reference/condition case; many listeners can judge it
unit_contract.source_group_role: related-source accounting and split control, not proof of independence
unit_contract.leakage_group_role: declared synthetic grouping only, not an independently sampled population unit
unit_contract.observed_case_summary: Equal weight per completed assigned listener pair; signed tick difference divided by ten. Correct-choice fraction uses every locked choice, including trials with incomplete paired ratings. Report denominators separately.
unit_contract.finite_planned_panel: Planned means remain null if any assigned measurement is missing; never replace missing values by zero or a population prediction.
unit_contract.source_conditional_population_target: Not estimated: a finite observed listener mean or fraction is not an estimate with validated population support or uncertainty.
unit_contract.population_average_target: Not estimated; frame, selection, dependence, weights, uncertainty and prospective gates remain unselected.

validation.registry: Require exact generated fixture registry and complete unique assignment inventory; each presentation is bound to its expected participant, source, case, reference, condition, analysis and leakage identities before joining responses.
validation.responses: Reject unknown or duplicate assignments, wrong presentations, trial IDs, role linkage, or response schemas. Missing entire responses remain visible through the planned registry.
validation.promotion: Consumer preflight rejects aggregate target adapters and all scientific source-label or population-inference requests. Finite case-summary routing remains synthetic-only.
validation.adversarial_tests: Tampered registry, crossed source/case/reference/condition/partition or role mapping, missing planned assignment, duplicate response, foreign response, forged eligibility, aggregate broadcast, and unsupported inference scope must fail closed.
validation.exact_arithmetic: Report means and fractions as reduced rational strings; no fit, rounding-based decision, confidence interval, or threshold is computed.
validation.public_projection: Only scenario/variant-level counts and histograms; no participant, source, case, assignment or stimulus rows or private paths.

next_requirements: Bind exact real reference and condition identity privately, independently of presentation aliases and grouping IDs, before any observed-response linkage is authorized.
Freeze the listener population and averaging rule for each source-conditional target; do not transfer aggregate minimum-source counts or intervals to a one-source target.
Declare source population, sampling frame and selection mechanism, independent units, crossing/nesting and weights before population validation.
Choose uncertainty, missingness, proper response-level scores and prospective acceptance criteria in a separately justified statistical successor.
Retain all source, metric, human calibration, full-reference and independent-transfer gates; this linkage checkpoint opens none.
